deploy-bot: Deploy initiated: rollout v1.4.0 -> 10% traffic (us-west1). Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/v1.4.0 :party:
olivia (eng-release): quick heads-up — this is the small-batch quantized change. watch latency + embed quality for first 10m
maria (sre): seeing a small tail latency bump on canaries (p95 from 210ms -> 380ms) starting ~30s after traffic shift
kevin (infra): noted. perf profile shows more GC on async batching path for this model variant. investigating whether kernel path changed with quantize flags
sam (oncall): any customer impact flags? are errors or just latency?
priya (product): support triage — want to know if higher latency causes timeouts for streaming sessions. any errors logged?
tina (support): getting a ticket (INC-2319) reporting slow responses from autocomplete in EU region — user pasted transcript: "suggestions take way longer"
maria (sre): logs: increased token-insert latency, no 5xx spike yet. error rate steady. tail latency correlated with bursty small requests.
kevin (infra): possible KVCACHE warmup + quantized kernel falling back to slower path under small sequence lengths. can we hold/observe for 5m? we need 2m to try a quick perf tweak
olivia (eng-release): quick vote: observe 5m (go) or pause + pin to v1.3.2 (hold). call from me in 60s for tally. please react or reply
sam (oncall): hold. customers already seeing slow UX. :thumbsup:
priya (product): hold. if streaming UX breaks we get churn. :thumbsup:
maria (sre): hold. tail is trending up, not comfortable with more ramp. :thumbsup:
kevin (infra): ok hold — I'll gather a perf dump and try a kernel toggle on a single canary CPU pool if we want to reattempt. :thumbsup:
tina (support): hold. adding note to INC-2319 and escalating to customer success
olivia (eng-release): consensus = HOLD. engaging rollback/pin process. tagging deploy-bot
olivia (eng-release): deploy-bot, pin rollout and roll back canaries to v1.3.2, reason: canary tail latency regression
deploy-bot: Command received: /deploy rollback --to v1.3.2 --scope canary --reason "tail latency regression on quantized path"
deploy-bot: Rolling back canary pool us-west1: started
deploy-bot: Rolling back canary pool us-west1: completed in 18s
deploy-bot: Pin applied: traffic for canary cohorts pinned to v1.3.2
maria (sre): metrics back to baseline (p95 ~215ms), no residual errors. marking incident as mitigated
kevin (infra): saved perf dump and kernel traces in https://internal.logs/trace/abc123 for postmortem
priya (product): thanks — I'll update release notes + customer comms draft
tina (support): updated INC-2319 with rollback timeline and customer note
olivia (eng-release): follow-up actions: 1) perf root-cause triage (infra + ml infra) 2) canary test with kernel toggle in staging 3) re-run small-batch evals. assigning owners in the postmortem
sam (oncall): leaving a short postmortem checklist in #incidents
deploy-bot: Rollback complete. status: SUCCESS. pinned version: v1.3.2. Change window closed.
olivia (eng-release): thanks everyone. we'll schedule a short RCA sync in 30m to decide next steps and whether to reattempt with a different config
